_doc: Woods mask for the sound engine (woods reverb boost, AUD-G08). Derived from the 1863 woods layer, docs/basemap1863/features/landcover/woods_1863.geojson. Rings are [lon, lat] (EPSG:4326); the first ring of a polygon is the outer boundary, the others are holes. TIER inferred: a reconstruction from the Warren survey of 1868-69 (LC cw0353500), positional error 30 to 40 m (SOURCES-landcover.md), timber cut in July 1863 and regrowth to 1869 are UNKNOWN; outside the Warren sheet nothing is known (treated as open).
